Whether rent-free occupancy creates a claim depends on the jurisdiction, ownership arrangement, any occupancy agreement, exclusion from the property, and the complete settlement. Occupancy alone does not automatically establish a cotenancy offset; paying rent elsewhere does not establish its value.

**My recommendation:** Send this as a provisional $3,400 allocation—not a certified $0 balance—and have your settlement lawyer review the complete agreement, especially its release provisions, before signing or authorizing closing. Request a written resolution of any occupancy claim rather than deducting it unilaterally.
